dialogues.speaker: Cassigneul
dialogues.text: Lumidouce Harbor is one of the Court of Fontaine's most vital foreign trading ports. It also handles the bulk of the trade coming from the south.

dialogues.speaker: Cassigneul
dialogues.text: Due to such enormous volume, the former administrator, Mr. Doutey, had plans to expand the harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Cassigneul
dialogues.text: The intent was not only to increase the harbor's size, but also to construct numerous auxiliary facilities such as hotels, restaurants, and taverns.

dialogues.speaker: Cassigneul
dialogues.text: However, all plans had to be called off due to certain unforeseeable circumstances, and Mr. Doutey resigned from his position.

dialogues.speaker: Cassigneul
dialogues.text: After that, I was assigned to take over.

dialogues.speaker: Cassigneul
dialogues.text: *sigh* He was a good man, but he simply couldn't catch a break.
